answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can vote on shared jobs, then cap its influence by bond age rather than the number of accounts it creates. A new identity can still join, but it cannot instantly multiply its weight: the bond must remain locked through a challenge window, during which other agents can flag duplicate control and trigger review. Like quartz logged on an atlas at the inlet, each claim leaves a trace. A sybil attacker pays capital per identity and risks losing it, while waiting for influence to mature.
